article.linkText: Top-25 SEC matchup features Florida visiting Missouri
article.story: No. 8 Florida (4-0) at No. 25 Missouri (3-1), Oct. 3 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Florida by 4.5. Against the spread: Florida 3-1, Missouri 1-3. How to watch: ABC Key stats Florida Offense Overall: 532.8 yards per game (5th in FBS) Passing: 272.8 yards per game (35th) Rushing: 260 yards per game (11th) Scoring: 53.5 points per game (2nd) Florida Defense Overall: 351.3 yards per game (72nd in FBS) Passing: 248.3 yards per game (113th) Rushing: 103 yards per game (35th) Scoring: 22.8 points per game (69th) Missouri Offense Overall: 418.8 yards per game (61st in FBS) Passing: 263 yards per game (42nd) Rushing: 155.8 yards per game (79th) Scoring: 35.8 points per game (43rd) Missouri Defense Overall: 318.8 yards per game (51st in FBS) Passing: 218.3 yards per game (81st) Rushing: 100.5 yards per game (32nd) Scoring: 20.8 points per game (51st) Both teams have a +4 turnover margin to rank 21st in the FBS. Both teams are heavily penalized. Florida ranks 134th in the FBS averaging 89.3 penalty yards per game, and Missouri ranks 117th with a 73-yard average. Missouri is 117th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 76.2% of trips. Florida's red zone defense ranks 49th at 80%. Missouri ranks 77th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:53, compared to Florida's 7th-ranked average of 34:04. Team leaders Florida Passing: Aaron Philo, 917 yards, 7 TDs, 2 INTs, 72.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jadan Baugh, 600 yards on 83 carries, 11 TDs Receiving: Vernell Brown III, 271 yards on 17 catches, 2 TDs Missouri Passing: Austin Simmons, 947 yards, 11 TDs, 0 INTs, 65.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jamal Roberts, 395 yards on 89 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Cayden Lee, 403 yards on 26 catches, 4 TDs Last game Florida won 52-28 over Ole Miss on Sept. 26. Philo led Florida with 196 yards on 16-of-23 passing (69.6%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball six times for 14 yards and one rushing touchdown. Baugh had 142 rushing yards on 29 carries and three touchdowns, adding one reception for 12 yards. Eric Singleton Jr. recorded 38 yards on one catch. Missouri lost 31-24 to Mississippi State on Sept. 26. Simmons threw for 295 yards on 23-of-39 attempts (59.0%) with three touchdowns and no interceptions. Roberts had 95 rushing yards on 26 carries, adding two receptions for 38 yards. Lee put up 156 yards on 11 catches with two touchdowns. Next game Florida hosts South Carolina on Oct. 10. Missouri hosts Texas A&M on Oct. 10.
